description: DDL replays as ClickHouse applies it: FIRST and AFTER place a column an ADD COLUMN or MODIFY COLUMN adds or moves, so SELECT * scans in table order; ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS of a column the table has and MODIFY COLUMN IF EXISTS of one it lacks change nothing; a repeated CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS changes nothing; RENAME TABLE renames tables and views, moving one to another database; and a view defined with a qualified star holds the table's columns
